features.name: Wasteland Strider Magic
features.description:
Also starting at 3rd level, you learn additional spells at certain ranger levels (don't count against spells known):

| Ranger Level | Spells |
|---|---|
| 3rd | protection from the void |
| 5th | calm emotions |
| 9th | dispel magic |
| 13th | banishment |
| 17th | hold monster |

features.name: Chaotic Strikes
features.description: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, as a bonus action, imbue your weapon with chaotic energy for 1 minute. Roll 1d8: 1=Fire, 2=Cold, 3=Lightning, 4=Psychic, 5=Necrotic, 6=Poison, 7=Radiant, 8=Force. While imbued, your weapon deals +1d4 of the rolled damage type on each hit. Ends if you drop the weapon or fall unconscious.

payload.name: Chaotic Strikes
payload.description: Imbue weapon for 1 min: roll d8 for damage type (1=Fire, 2=Cold, 3=Lightning, 4=Psychic, 5=Necrotic, 6=Poison, 7=Radiant, 8=Force). Deals +1d4 of that type per hit.

features.name: Stalwart Psyche
features.description: Starting at 7th level, you have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened and on ability checks and saving throws to discern illusions.

features.name: Call the Otherworldly
features.description:
At 11th level, as an action, summon a friendly fiend or aberration of CR 2 or lower in an unoccupied space within 30 ft. Obeys verbal commands, rolls its own initiative. Disappears after 1 hour, on your incapacitation, or at 0 HP. 1/short or long rest.

At 17th level, can summon CR 5 or lower.

payload.name: Call the Otherworldly
payload.description: Summon friendly fiend or aberration CR 2 or lower (CR 5 at L17) within 30 ft for 1 hour.

features.name: Dimensional Step
features.description: At 15th level, you can cast *dimension door* without expending a spell slot. Uses equal to proficiency bonus; regain all on long rest.
